message.content:
{
  "decision": "APPLY",
  "workflow_yaml": "name: CI

on: [push]

jobs:
  lib-build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        node_version:
        - "15"
        - "16"
        - "17"
    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v2
    - uses: actions/setup-node@v2
      with:
        node-version: ${{ matrix.node_version }}
    - name: Cache npm dependencies
      uses: actions/cache@v4
      with:
        path: ~/.npm
        key: ${{ runner.os }}-node-${{ matrix.node_version }}-${{ hashFiles('package-lock.json') }}
    - run: npm install
    - run: npm test
    - name: IRC Message Action
      uses: Gottox/irc-message-action@main
      if: failure()
      with:
        channel: "Gottox"
        nickname: gh-gottox
        message: |-
          [${{ github.workflow }} failed] ${{ github.ref }} https://github.com/${{ github.repository }}/actions/runs/${{ github.run_id }}
",
  "rationale": "The repository is a Node.js project with package-lock.json that runs `npm install` across a three-version Node matrix and has no existing dependency cache. The P-LIT-GHA-CACHE pattern is supported by measured evidence (experiment:batch-interactive-three--f6d2974a5cef7cc9, 6.06% elapsed savings on a fork; pattern:P-LIT-GHA-CACHE). Prerequisites are met: repeated dependency fetching occurs on every push/matrix cell, and cache inputs include the lockfile plus runner/Node environment. Adding an `actions/cache` step for `~/.npm` keyed on `runner.os`, `matrix.node_version`, and `hashFiles('package-lock.json')` preserves every build/test step and required check, falls back to a full `npm install` on a miss, and adds no privileged actions, secrets, publishing/deployment, or unrelated network access.",
  "evidence_ids": ["experiment:batch-interactive-three--f6d2974a5cef7cc9", "pattern:P-LIT-GHA-CACHE"]
}
